name: You & Your Heroic Foolishness
source:
After the war of independence of the Feritas territories, Major Robin Howl has left the military life behind to follow his calling as a law maker in this new independent country. However, while working in Cross’ Law firm as an attorney, he is approached by Holly Loreville– His old wartime subordinate who he had an intense, romantic fling while she was pretending to be a man named Caspian. 

She has been involved in a crime, and Robin is the only person she can turn to that isn’t under her family’s influence– This will lead them to untangling a crime motivated by passion and hate, while embarking in a self-discovery journey of figuring out what and who are they after everything that went down in those muddy fields. 

[From [url=https://milekael.itch.io/your-heroic-foolishness]Itch.io[/url]]
